name: kde-agent-workspace
description: Give Claude its own KDE Plasma virtual desktop: list desktops, create a "Claude" or "AI Agents" desktop, launch and test GUI or terminal apps there without taking over the user's screen (AT-SPI input, KWin window capture), bind the agent desktop to its own display output, and run Claude in Chrome in a Chrome window on the agent desktop instead of the user's (with a CLAUDE.md directive making that the default). Plasma 6 on Wayland.
